title: Scale-factor reordering in quantized operator caused accuracy drift and intermittent crash loops — follow-up and canary rollout
creator: Priya Shah
description: Summary: A change in the kernel packing optimization (merged in runtime-1.22) reordered per-channel scale metadata for a subset of fused quantized operators. This reorder is semantically benign for single-threaded builds but caused subtle misalignment when (a) per-channel quantization metadata and (b) fused attention/cross-attention kernels were both used and (c) KV cache eviction triggered reused tensor views. Symptoms: production traffic for two internal customers observed 3-7% accuracy degradation on long-context chat prompts and, in a smaller population of requests, a crash loop triggered by invalid dequant reads (SIGSEGV). Impact: the regression surfaced in ~0.8% of hosted requests for models with Per-Channel dynamic quant (mostly LLM-XL variants) between 2026-03-09 22:00 UTC and 2026-03-10 06:00 UTC. Root cause: a CI performance refactor changed the order of scale-factor writes when serializing fused operator metadata. Under certain memory layout and batch-size permutations the runtime read a mismatched scale for some channels, causing deterministic but rare numeric shifts and, when combined with KV-cache eviction reuse, out-of-bounds accesses. Why this escaped tests: our unit tests used randomized but narrow batch-size/sequence-length distributions and did not include fused-op + KV-eviction conformance paths. Actions already taken: immediate mitigation was enabling an automatic fallback that routes impacted model variants to an older operator path (float32 fallback or unfused quant dequant path) for traffic tagged by model-hash. We also created a targeted canary and rolling rollback for the leaves of runtime-1.22. Decisions: we will backport the kernel serialization fix, add deterministic operator fingerprinting in the model load path, add a conformance matrix to CI for fused-op + KV eviction permutations, and expand production detection rules to capture small but persistent accuracy shifts (not just crashes).

2026-03-10 04:30 UTC - Priya Shah: Postmortem draft started. Collected crash dumps and kernel metadata; attached sample trace. Noticed identical pattern across two models with per-channel quant. Added preliminary labels and created ENG-41358 to track follow-ups.

2026-03-11 09:40 UTC - Anna Liu (SRE): Observability rule updated to capture >0.5% drift in BLEU-like eval over 1h window for production prompts. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/quant-drift?panel=12

2026-03-12 16:20 UTC - Marco Fernandes (Runtime): Reproduced misread locally using synthetic packed metadata generator. Root cause narrowed to metadata write-order change introduced by commit a1b2c3. Draft PR prepared to restore deterministic order. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5892

2026-03-13 11:02 UTC - UX/PM review (Leila): Confirmed customer proxies impacted; coordinated messaging plan for affected customers and support playbooks. Draft sent to legal for C-level notification review.

2026-03-14 08:50 UTC - Ethan Moore: Canaries configured for runtime-1.22 patch. Canary traffic ramp plan: 1% for 2h -> 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h. Rollback criteria: >0.5% BLEU drift or any crash rate increase above baseline. Will monitor closely and expand CI once patch merged.

(A2) Add deterministic operator fingerprint to model-load path and store in model metadata for routing/fallback (owner: Ethan Moore, estimate: 3) - due 2026-03-18
(A3) Extend CI conformance matrix to include fused-op + KV-cache-eviction permutations and randomized large-batch sequence tests (owner: QA Team, estimate: 8) - due 2026-04-01

(A4) Implement an automated post-deploy canary comparator that detects sub-1% accuracy regressions on selected prompt sets and triggers automated rollback/alerts (owner: Anna Liu, estimate: 8) - due 2026-03-28
(A5) Create a small synthetic fuzz harness that serializes/deserializes operator metadata with varied packing and validates per-channel scales (owner: Marco Fernandes, estimate: 5) - due 2026-03-22

(A6) Customer comms & support playbook: notify affected customers, provide opt-out for new runtime until hotfix applied, and coordinate postmortem summary (owner: Leila Gomez, estimate: 2) - due 2026-03-15
